name: Emberon-1.2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. LoRA fine-tune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, merged into the base weights, specialised for DICTATION CLEANUP: it reformats dictated speech and is trained to never answer or act on the content. 1.170B, same tensor set as the base. Hosted as GGUF only (F16 + Q4_K_M), which is why it reads like a repack - it is not: the merged weights are a different model, and the card's own bf16-vs-Q4_K_M check shows quantization preserved the behaviour (0.963 vs 0.953 word-preservation). Recorded because the Headline table puts stock LFM2.5 and this model side by side with an identical zero-shot prompt: answer-suppression 71.0% -> 100.0% (493/493), word-preservation 0.780 -> 0.953, identifier-preservation 0.833 -> 0.968, hallucination rate 13.3% -> 0.00% (0/1,152). The metric is the author's own and is task-specific - it says nothing about general capability, and no MMLU/GSM8K/IFEval is published - so compare it only against other dictation-cleanup models. Base rows for word- and identifier-preservation are scored on n=300 and unstated n respectively against Emberon's n=1,152, so those two gaps are not clean paired comparisons; answer-suppression and hallucination are.

benchmarks.name: Answer-suppression (held-out answer-temptation, n=493)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Headline' table '| Metric | Emberon-1.2B (Q4_K_M) | Stock LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct | bf16 reference |': stock LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct 71.0% vs Emberon 100.0% (493/493), given the identical zero-shot system prompt. Measured through llama.cpp on the shipped Q4_K_M GGUF. Author-defined metric for the model's only task (dictation cleanup): % of answer-tempting inputs cleaned rather than answered.
